prompts.player: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent RPG Maker MZ overworld walking sprite sheet. Input image is the identity, costume, palette, pixel-art style and walking pose reference for ONE character. Generate a NEW refined sheet of the SAME character: Hayato: young black-haired samurai with topknot, dark navy kimono, charcoal pleated hakama, sandals and sheathed sword at his waist. Preserve the recognizable reference design without adding accessories. Enlarge/redraw with clean readable details for a final visible standing body height around 69 pixels (15 percent larger than reference after export). Output exactly 12 complete full-body figures in an evenly spaced THREE-column FOUR-row grid on a genuinely transparent background. Rows strictly: front/down, left-facing profile, right-facing profile, back/up. Columns strictly: walking left foot forward, neutral standing feet together, walking right foot forward. Same body height and costume in all frames, coherent head size and leg lengths, consistent top-left lighting, correct mirrored travel directions. Feet on equal baseline within each row; no exaggerated bobbing; blade remains sheathed. Generous transparent gaps between cells and canvas edges. No grid, labels, captions, ground shadows, background, border, extra poses or clipped weapons. Crisp pixel-art RPG sprites matching reference, no painterly blur. Sheet aspect ratio 3:5 approximately. Final cells will be 64x88 pixels, feet horizontally centered.
